quote: The operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter shall not: Intentionally interfere with the movement of a motor vehicle.

activation.condition: Operator of a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter interacting with a distinct motor vehicle

obligation.description: Do not intentionally interfere with the movement of a motor vehicle.

timing.description: Original approach, crossing or lane holding, and motor vehicle response history.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Intentionally interfere with the movement of a motor vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Authored purpose and original motor movement are separate evidence; physical braking or lane occupancy cannot establish intent or a legal conclusion.
